ندارأ (form VI)
# نَدَّارَأُ (naddāraʔu) /nad.daː.ra.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِدَّارَأَ (iddāraʔa)
# نَدَّارَأَ (naddāraʔa) /nad.daː.ra.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِدَّارَأَ (iddāraʔa)
# نَدَّارَأْ (naddāraʔ) /nad.daː.raʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِدَّارَأَ (iddāraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
